terms.definition_en: Software that manages computer hardware and software resources
terms.definition_zh: 管理计算机硬件和软件资源的系统软件
terms.example_zh: 我们需要升级操作系统版本。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào shēngjí cāozuò xìtǒng bǎnběn.
terms.example_en: We need to upgrade the operating system version.

terms.definition_en: Core component of an operating system managing system resources
terms.definition_zh: 操作系统的核心组件，管理系统资源
terms.example_zh: 这个内核版本支持新的硬件。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège nèihé bǎnběn zhīchí xīn de yìngjiàn.
terms.example_en: This kernel version supports new hardware.

terms.definition_en: Software that enables communication between OS and hardware
terms.definition_zh: 使操作系统与硬件通信的软件
terms.example_zh: 请安装最新的显卡驱动。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng ānzhuāng zuìxīn de xiǎnkǎ qūdòng.
terms.example_en: Please install the latest graphics driver.

terms.definition_en: Software stored in non-volatile memory for hardware control
terms.definition_zh: 存储在非易失性存储器中用于控制硬件的软件
terms.example_zh: 需要更新路由器的固件。
terms.example_pinyin: Xūyào gēngxīn lùyóuqì de gùjiàn.
terms.example_en: Need to update the router firmware.

terms.definition_en: Program that loads the operating system during startup
terms.definition_zh: 在启动时加载操作系统的程序
terms.example_zh: 解锁 bootloader 才能刷机。
terms.example_pinyin: Jiěsuǒ bootloader cáinéng shuājī.
terms.example_en: Unlock the bootloader to flash the device.

terms.definition_en: Abstraction layer between hardware and software
terms.definition_zh: 硬件和软件之间的抽象层
terms.example_zh: HAL 让上层应用不依赖具体硬件。
terms.example_pinyin: HAL ràng shàngcéng yìngyòng bù yīlài jùtǐ yìngjiàn.
terms.example_en: HAL allows upper-layer applications to be independent of specific hardware.

terms.definition_en: Reusable set of libraries and conventions for software development
terms.definition_zh: 用于软件开发的可重用库和约定集合
terms.example_zh: 我们使用 Spring 框架开发后端。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen shǐyòng Spring kuàngjià kāifā hòuduān.
terms.example_en: We use the Spring framework for backend development.

terms.definition_en: Topmost layer in a software stack that provides user-facing functionality
terms.definition_zh: 软件栈中最顶层，提供面向用户的功能
terms.example_zh: 应用层负责处理用户输入。
terms.example_pinyin: Yìngyòng céng fùzé chǔlǐ yònghù shūrù.
terms.example_en: The application layer handles user input.

terms.definition_en: Background process that provides core system functionality
terms.definition_zh: 提供核心系统功能的后台进程
terms.example_zh: 系统服务在后台运行。
terms.example_pinyin: Xìtǒng fúwù zài hòutái yùnxíng.
terms.example_en: System services run in the background.

terms.definition_en: Instance of a program in execution with its own memory space
terms.definition_zh: 正在执行的程序实例，拥有独立的内存空间
terms.example_zh: 每个应用运行在独立的进程中。
terms.example_pinyin: Měi gè yìngyòng yùnxíng zài dúlì de jìnchéng zhōng.
terms.example_en: Each app runs in a separate process.

terms.definition_en: Smallest unit of execution within a process
terms.definition_zh: 进程内最小的执行单元
terms.example_zh: 主线程不能执行耗时操作。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhǔ xiànchéng bùnéng zhíxíng hàoshí cāozuò.
terms.example_en: The main thread should not perform time-consuming operations.

terms.definition_en: Hardware component that stores data temporarily for fast access
terms.definition_zh: 临时存储数据以便快速访问的硬件组件
terms.example_zh: 这个应用占用太多内存。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège yìngyòng zhànyòng tài duō nèicún.
terms.example_en: This app consumes too much memory.

terms.definition_en: Data structure that follows LIFO principle, used for function calls
terms.definition_zh: 遵循后进先出原则的数据结构，用于函数调用
terms.example_zh: 栈溢出通常由递归过深引起。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhàn yìchū tōngcháng yóu dìguī guò shēn yǐnqǐ.
terms.example_en: Stack overflow is usually caused by deep recursion.

terms.definition_en: Series of states an object or component goes through from creation to destruction
terms.definition_zh: 对象或组件从创建到销毁经历的一系列状态
terms.example_zh: Activity 有完整的生命周期回调。
terms.example_pinyin: Activity yǒu wánzhěng de shēngmìng zhōuqī huídiào.
terms.example_en: Activity has a complete lifecycle callback.

terms.definition_en: Environment information that provides access to system resources
terms.definition_zh: 提供系统资源访问的环境信息
terms.example_zh: 在 Activity 中获取 Context 对象。
terms.example_pinyin: Zài Activity zhōng huòqǔ Context duìxiàng.
terms.example_en: Get the Context object in an Activity.

terms.definition_en: Messaging object used to request an action from another component
terms.definition_zh: 用于请求其他组件执行操作的消息对象
terms.example_zh: 使用 Intent 启动另一个 Activity。
terms.example_pinyin: Shǐyòng Intent qǐdòng lìng yī gè Activity.
terms.example_en: Use Intent to start another Activity.

terms.definition_en: Android component representing a single screen with a user interface
terms.definition_zh: Android 中代表单个屏幕界面的组件
terms.example_zh: 每个 Activity 对应一个界面。
terms.example_pinyin: Měi gè Activity duìyìng yī gè jièmiàn.
terms.example_en: Each Activity corresponds to a screen.

terms.definition_en: Android component for long-running background operations
terms.definition_zh: Android 中用于长时间后台运行的组件
terms.example_zh: Service 在后台播放音乐。
terms.example_pinyin: Service zài hòutái bōfàng yīnyuè.
terms.example_en: Service plays music in the background.

terms.definition_en: Android component that responds to system-wide broadcast announcements
terms.definition_zh: Android 中响应系统广播的组件
terms.example_zh: 注册 BroadcastReceiver 监听网络变化。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhùcè BroadcastReceiver jiāntīng wǎngluò biànhuà.
terms.example_en: Register a BroadcastReceiver to listen for network changes.

terms.definition_en: Android component that manages shared data access
terms.definition_zh: Android 中管理共享数据访问的组件
terms.example_zh: ContentProvider 用于跨应用共享数据。
terms.example_pinyin: ContentProvider yòng yú kuà yìngyòng gòngxiǎng shùjù.
terms.example_en: ContentProvider is used to share data across apps.

terms.definition_en: Reusable portion of an Activity's UI
terms.definition_zh: Activity 中可重用的 UI 片段
terms.example_zh: Fragment 可以动态添加到 Activity。
terms.example_pinyin: Fragment kěyǐ dòngtài tiānjiā dào Activity.
terms.example_en: Fragment can be dynamically added to an Activity.

terms.definition_en: Basic building block for user interface components
terms.definition_zh: 用户界面组件的基本构建块
terms.example_zh: 自定义 View 需要重写 onDraw 方法。
terms.example_pinyin: Zìdìngyì View xūyào chóngxiě onDraw fāngfǎ.
terms.example_en: Custom View needs to override the onDraw method.

terms.definition_en: Definition of the arrangement of UI elements
terms.definition_zh: UI 元素排列方式的定义
terms.example_zh: 使用 LinearLayout 实现线性布局。
terms.example_pinyin: Shǐyòng LinearLayout shíxiàn xiànxìng bùjú.
terms.example_en: Use LinearLayout to achieve a linear layout.

terms.definition_en: External files or values used by an app, such as strings and images
terms.definition_zh: 应用使用的外部文件或值，如字符串和图片
terms.example_zh: 字符串资源定义在 strings.xml 中。
terms.example_pinyin: Zìfúchuàn zīyuán dìngyì zài strings.xml zhōng.
terms.example_en: String resources are defined in strings.xml.

terms.definition_en: Object that bridges data and UI components
terms.definition_zh: 桥接数据和 UI 组件的对象
terms.example_zh: RecyclerView 需要设置 Adapter。
terms.example_pinyin: RecyclerView xūyào shèzhì Adapter.
terms.example_en: RecyclerView needs an Adapter set.

terms.definition_en: Authorization granted to an app to access specific device resources or data.
terms.definition_zh: 授予应用程序访问特定设备资源或数据的授权。
terms.example_zh: 这个应用需要相机权限才能扫描二维码。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège yìngyòng xūyào xiàngjī quánxiàn cáinéng sǎomiáo èrwéimǎ.
terms.example_en: This app needs camera permission to scan QR codes.

terms.definition_en: Digital certificate used to verify the authenticity and integrity of an app.
terms.definition_zh: 用于验证应用程序真实性和完整性的数字证书。
terms.example_zh: APK签名不一致会导致安装失败。
terms.example_pinyin: APK qiānmíng bù yīzhì huì dǎozhì ānzhuāng shībài.
terms.example_en: Inconsistent APK signatures will cause installation failure.

terms.definition_en: Unique identifier for an Android app, typically in reverse domain notation.
terms.definition_zh: Android应用的唯一标识符，通常采用反向域名表示法。
terms.example_zh: 请确认包名是否正确，否则无法定位到应用。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng quèrèn bāomíng shìfǒu zhèngquè, fǒuzé wúfǎ dìngwèi dào yìngyòng.
terms.example_en: Please confirm the package name is correct, otherwise the app cannot be located.

terms.definition_en: Digital distribution platform for mobile applications.
terms.definition_zh: 移动应用的数字分发平台。
terms.example_zh: 我们的应用已经在各大应用商店上架。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen de yìngyòng yǐjīng zài gè dà yìngyòng shāngdiàn shàngjià.
terms.example_en: Our app has been listed on major app stores.

terms.definition_en: Software that simulates a device's hardware and operating system for testing.
terms.definition_zh: 模拟设备硬件和操作系统的测试软件。
terms.example_zh: 在模拟器上测试基本功能，真机测试兼容性。
terms.example_pinyin: Zài mónǐ qì shàng cèshì jīběn gōngnéng, zhēnjī cèshì jiānróngxìng.
terms.example_en: Test basic functions on the emulator, and compatibility on real devices.

terms.definition_en: Physical hardware device used for testing, as opposed to an emulator.
terms.definition_zh: 用于测试的物理硬件设备，与模拟器相对。
terms.example_zh: 这个bug只在真机上出现，模拟器无法复现。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège bug zhǐ zài zhēnjī shàng chūxiàn, mónǐ qì wúfǎ fùxiàn.
terms.example_en: This bug only appears on real devices and cannot be reproduced on the emulator.

terms.definition_en: Command-line tool for communicating with an Android device for debugging.
terms.definition_zh: 用于与Android设备通信进行调试的命令行工具。
terms.example_zh: 用ADB命令安装APK并查看日志。
terms.example_pinyin: Yòng ADB mìnglìng ānzhuāng APK bìng chákàn rìzhì.
terms.example_en: Use ADB commands to install APK and view logs.

terms.definition_en: Recorded output of system or application events used for debugging.
terms.definition_zh: 系统或应用程序事件的记录输出，用于调试。
terms.example_zh: 请把崩溃时的日志发给我分析。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng bǎ bēngkuì shí de rìzhì fā gěi wǒ fēnxī.
terms.example_en: Please send me the log at the time of the crash for analysis.

terms.definition_en: Android tool for capturing and viewing system log messages.
terms.definition_zh: 用于捕获和查看系统日志消息的Android工具。
terms.example_zh: 使用logcat命令抓取应用运行时的日志。
terms.example_pinyin: Shǐyòng logcat mìnglìng zhuāqǔ yìngyòng yùnxíng shí de rìzhì.
terms.example_en: Use the logcat command to capture logs while the app is running.

terms.definition_en: Unexpected termination of an application due to an error.
terms.definition_zh: 由于错误导致应用程序意外终止。
terms.example_zh: 这个版本修复了之前的内存泄漏导致的崩溃。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège bǎnběn xiūfù le zhīqián de nèicún xièlòu dǎozhì de bēngkuì.
terms.example_en: This version fixes the crash caused by the previous memory leak.

terms.definition_en: Application Not Responding, occurs when the UI thread is blocked for too long.
terms.definition_zh: 应用程序无响应，当UI线程被阻塞过长时间时发生。
terms.example_zh: 主线程做了耗时操作会导致ANR。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhǔ xiànchéng zuò le hàoshí cāozuò huì dǎozhì ANR.
terms.example_en: Performing time-consuming operations on the main thread will cause ANR.

terms.definition_en: Perceptible stutter or lag in UI rendering due to frame drops.
terms.definition_zh: 由于掉帧导致的UI渲染可感知的停顿或延迟。
terms.example_zh: 列表滑动时出现卡顿，需要优化布局。
terms.example_pinyin: Lièbiǎo huádòng shí chūxiàn kǎdùn, xūyào yōuhuà bùjú.
terms.example_en: Jank occurs when scrolling the list; the layout needs optimization.

terms.definition_en: Failure to render a frame within the allotted time, causing visual stutter.
terms.definition_zh: 未能在规定时间内渲染帧，导致视觉卡顿。
terms.example_zh: 动画掉帧严重，需要检查渲染性能。
terms.example_pinyin: Dònghuà diào zhēn yánzhòng, xūyào jiǎnchá xuànrǎn xìngnéng.
terms.example_en: The animation has severe frame drops; rendering performance needs to be checked.

terms.definition_en: Failure to release unused memory, causing gradual memory consumption increase.
terms.definition_zh: 未能释放不再使用的内存，导致内存占用逐渐增加。
terms.example_zh: Activity未释放导致内存泄漏，使用弱引用解决。
terms.example_pinyin: Activity wèi shìfàng dǎozhì nèicún xièlòu, shǐyòng ruò yǐnyòng jiějué.
terms.example_en: Activity not being released causes a memory leak; use weak references to fix.

terms.definition_en: Electrical charge stored in a device's battery, often measured in percentage.
terms.definition_zh: 设备电池中存储的电能，通常以百分比衡量。
terms.example_zh: 后台定位服务会快速消耗电量。
terms.example_pinyin: Hòutái dìngwèi fúwù huì kuàisù xiāohào diànliàng.
terms.example_en: Background location services drain battery quickly.

terms.definition_en: Excessive heat generation in a device due to high CPU/GPU usage.
terms.definition_zh: 由于CPU/GPU使用率高导致设备过热。
terms.example_zh: 游戏运行时间过长会导致手机发热。
terms.example_pinyin: Yóuxì yùnxíng shíjiān guò cháng huì dǎozhì shǒujī fārè.
terms.example_en: Running games for too long can cause the phone to overheat.

terms.definition_en: Starting an app from scratch, without any cached process or data.
terms.definition_zh: 从零开始启动应用，没有缓存的进程或数据。
terms.example_zh: 冷启动时间超过5秒需要优化。
terms.example_pinyin: Lěng qǐdòng shíjiān chāoguò 5 miǎo xūyào yōuhuà.
terms.example_en: Cold start time exceeding 5 seconds needs optimization.

terms.definition_en: Restarting an app that was previously in memory, resulting in faster launch.
terms.definition_zh: 重新启动之前已在内存中的应用，启动速度更快。
terms.example_zh: 热启动性能通常比冷启动好很多。
terms.example_pinyin: Rè qǐdòng xìngnéng tōngcháng bǐ lěng qǐdòng hǎo hěnduō.
terms.example_en: Hot start performance is usually much better than cold start.

terms.definition_en: Time taken for an app to become interactive after launch.
terms.definition_zh: 应用启动后变得可交互所需的时间。
terms.example_zh: 我们设定了启动时间不超过3秒的目标。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen shèdìng le qǐdòng shíjiān bù chāoguò 3 miǎo de mùbiāo.
terms.example_en: We set a target of startup time not exceeding 3 seconds.

terms.definition_en: Ability of an app to run correctly on different devices and OS versions.
terms.definition_zh: 应用在不同设备和操作系统版本上正确运行的能力。
terms.example_zh: 需要测试所有主流机型的兼容性。
terms.example_pinyin: Xūyào cèshì suǒyǒu zhǔliú jīxíng de jiānróngxìng.
terms.example_en: We need to test compatibility on all mainstream devices.

terms.definition_en: Diversity of Android device models, screen sizes, and OS versions.
terms.definition_zh: Android设备型号、屏幕尺寸和操作系统版本的多样性。
terms.example_zh: Android碎片化严重，适配工作量大。
terms.example_pinyin: Android suìpiànhuà yánzhòng, shìpèi gōngzuò liàng dà.
terms.example_en: Android fragmentation is severe, requiring significant adaptation work.

terms.definition_en: Process of installing a new firmware or operating system on a device.
terms.definition_zh: 在设备上安装新固件或操作系统的过程。
terms.example_zh: 刷机可以解决系统层面的问题。
terms.example_pinyin: Shuā jī kěyǐ jiějué xìtǒng céngmiàn de wèntí.
terms.example_en: Flashing the device can resolve system-level issues.

terms.definition_en: Superuser access allowing modification of system files and settings.
terms.definition_zh: 允许修改系统文件和设置的最高权限。
terms.example_zh: 获取Root权限后可以卸载预装应用。
terms.example_pinyin: Huòqǔ Root quánxiàn hòu kěyǐ xièzài yùzhuāng yìngyòng.
terms.example_en: With root access, you can uninstall pre-installed apps.

terms.definition_en: Special bootable partition used for system recovery and firmware updates.
terms.definition_zh: 用于系统恢复和固件更新的特殊可启动分区。
terms.example_zh: 进入恢复模式后可以清除数据或刷入更新包。
terms.example_pinyin: Jìnrù huīfù móshì hòu kěyǐ qīngchú shùjù huò shuārù gēngxīn bāo.
terms.example_en: In recovery mode, you can wipe data or flash update packages.

terms.definition_en: Logical division of storage space for different purposes like system, data, cache.
terms.definition_zh: 存储空间的逻辑划分，用于系统、数据、缓存等不同用途。
terms.example_zh: 系统分区空间不足会导致无法升级。
terms.example_pinyin: Xìtǒng fēnqū kōngjiān bùzú huì dǎozhì wúfǎ shēngjí.
terms.example_en: Insufficient space in the system partition will prevent upgrades.

terms.definition_en: A partition that contains the operating system and system apps.
terms.definition_zh: 包含操作系统和系统应用的分区。
terms.example_zh: 刷机前需要先格式化系统分区。
terms.example_pinyin: Shuājī qián xūyào xiān gēshìhuà xìtǒng fēnqū.
terms.example_en: Before flashing, you need to format the system partition.

terms.definition_en: Data generated by user-installed apps and user settings.
terms.definition_zh: 用户安装的应用和设置产生的数据。
terms.example_zh: 恢复出厂设置会清除所有用户数据。
terms.example_pinyin: Huīfù chūchǎng shèzhì huì qīngchú suǒyǒu yònghù shùjù.
terms.example_en: Factory reset will erase all user data.

terms.definition_en: A partition that stores temporary system and app data to speed up access.
terms.definition_zh: 存储临时系统和应用数据以加快访问速度的分区。
terms.example_zh: 清除缓存分区可以解决一些系统问题。
terms.example_pinyin: Qīngchú huǎncún fēnqū kěyǐ jiějué yīxiē xìtǒng wèntí.
terms.example_en: Clearing the cache partition can fix some system issues.

terms.definition_en: Over-the-air update that delivers firmware updates wirelessly.
terms.definition_zh: 通过无线网络推送固件更新的方式。
terms.example_zh: 系统推送了OTA升级，请及时安装。
terms.example_pinyin: Xìtǒng tuīsòng le OTA shēngjí, qǐng jíshí ānzhuāng.
terms.example_en: The system has pushed an OTA update, please install it promptly.

terms.definition_en: Android application package file used for installing apps.
terms.definition_zh: 用于安装应用的Android应用包文件。
terms.example_zh: 请把APK文件放到手机存储里再安装。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng bǎ APK wénjiàn fàng dào shǒujī cúnchǔ lǐ zài ānzhuāng.
terms.example_en: Please put the APK file in the phone storage and then install it.

terms.definition_en: A publishing format that includes all app resources and code, enabling optimized APK generation.
terms.definition_zh: 一种包含所有应用资源和代码的发布格式，可生成优化的APK。
terms.example_zh: 从2021年起，Google Play要求新应用使用AAB格式上传。
terms.example_pinyin: Cóng 2021 nián qǐ, Google Play yāoqiú xīn yìngyòng shǐyòng AAB géshì shàngchuán.
terms.example_en: Since 2021, Google Play requires new apps to be uploaded in AAB format.

terms.definition_en: A tool to shrink, optimize, and obfuscate Java bytecode.
terms.definition_zh: 用于压缩、优化和混淆Java字节码的工具。
terms.example_zh: 发布前记得开启ProGuard进行代码混淆。
terms.example_pinyin: Fābù qián jìde kāiqǐ ProGuard jìnxíng dàimǎ hùnxiáo.
terms.example_en: Remember to enable ProGuard for code obfuscation before release.

terms.definition_en: Permissions requested from the user while the app is running, introduced in Android 6.0.
terms.definition_zh: 在应用运行时向用户请求的权限，Android 6.0引入。
terms.example_zh: Android 6.0以上需要动态申请运行时权限。
terms.example_pinyin: Android 6.0 yǐshàng xūyào dòngtài shēnqǐng yùnxíng shí quánxiàn.
terms.example_en: Android 6.0 and above require dynamic runtime permission requests.

terms.definition_en: Android's inter-process communication (IPC) mechanism.
terms.definition_zh: Android的进程间通信机制。
terms.example_zh: Binder机制是Android系统核心组件之一。
terms.example_pinyin: Binder jīzhì shì Android xìtǒng héxīn zǔjiàn zhī yī.
terms.example_en: The Binder mechanism is one of the core components of the Android system.

terms.definition_en: A system process in Android that serves as the parent of all app processes.
terms.definition_zh: Android中作为所有应用进程父进程的系统进程。
terms.example_zh: Zygote进程在系统启动时被创建。
terms.example_pinyin: Zygote jìnchéng zài xìtǒng qǐdòng shí bèi chuàngjiàn.
terms.example_en: The Zygote process is created when the system boots.

terms.definition_en: The process of evaluating software to find defects and ensure quality.
terms.definition_zh: 评估软件以发现缺陷并确保质量的过程。
terms.example_zh: 今天下午我们进行功能测试。
terms.example_pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒmen jìnxíng gōngnéng cèshì.
terms.example_en: We will conduct functional testing this afternoon.

terms.definition_en: A set of conditions and steps to verify a specific feature.
terms.definition_zh: 用于验证特定功能的一组条件和步骤。
terms.example_zh: 请根据需求编写测试用例。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng gēnjù xūqiú biānxiě cèshì yònglì.
terms.example_en: Please write test cases based on the requirements.

terms.definition_en: A document outlining the scope, approach, resources, and schedule of testing.
terms.definition_zh: 概述测试范围、方法、资源和进度的文档。
terms.example_zh: 测试计划需要在项目启动前完成。
terms.example_pinyin: Cèshì jìhuà xūyào zài xiàngmù qǐdòng qián wánchéng.
terms.example_en: The test plan needs to be completed before project kickoff.

terms.definition_en: A document summarizing test results, defects, and quality metrics.
terms.definition_zh: 总结测试结果、缺陷和质量指标的文档。
terms.example_zh: 测试报告要包含通过率和缺陷统计。
terms.example_pinyin: Cèshì bàogào yào bāohán tōngguò lǜ hé quēxiàn tǒngjì.
terms.example_en: The test report should include pass rate and defect statistics.

terms.definition_en: An imperfection or deficiency in a software product.
terms.definition_zh: 软件产品中的不完善或不足之处。
terms.example_zh: 这个缺陷的优先级是P1，需要立即修复。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège quēxiàn de yōuxiān jí shì P1, xūyào lìjí xiūfù.
terms.example_en: This defect has priority P1 and needs to be fixed immediately.

terms.definition_en: A flaw in software that causes unexpected behavior or security issues.
terms.definition_zh: 导致意外行为或安全问题的软件缺陷。
terms.example_zh: 这个漏洞会导致应用崩溃。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège lòudòng huì dǎozhì yìngyòng bēngkuì.
terms.example_en: This bug causes the app to crash.

terms.definition_en: To create a ticket in a bug tracking system to report an issue.
terms.definition_zh: 在缺陷跟踪系统中创建工单以报告问题。
terms.example_zh: 发现bug后请及时提单。
terms.example_pinyin: Fāxiàn bug hòu qǐng jíshí tí dān.
terms.example_en: Please file a ticket promptly after finding a bug.

terms.definition_en: A ticket that documents a bug report.
terms.definition_zh: 记录缺陷报告的工单。
terms.example_zh: 这个Bug单需要分配给开发人员。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège Bug dān xūyào fēnpèi gěi kāifā rényuán.
terms.example_en: This bug ticket needs to be assigned to a developer.

terms.definition_en: To recreate a bug or issue consistently.
terms.definition_zh: 一致地重现某个缺陷或问题。
terms.example_zh: 这个bug在最新版本上无法复现。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège bug zài zuìxīn bǎnběn shàng wúfǎ fùxiàn.
terms.example_en: This bug cannot be reproduced on the latest version.

terms.definition_en: To confirm that a fix or feature works as expected.
terms.definition_zh: 确认修复或功能按预期工作。
terms.example_zh: 修复完成后请开发人员自测，然后提交测试验证。
terms.example_pinyin: Xiūfù wánchéng hòu qǐng kāifā rényuán zìcè, ránhòu tíjiāo cèshì yànzhèng.
terms.example_en: After the fix, developers should self-test, then submit for test verification.

terms.definition_en: To mark a ticket as resolved and closed.
terms.definition_zh: 将工单标记为已解决并关闭。
terms.example_zh: 验证通过后可以关闭这个Bug单。
terms.example_pinyin: Yànzhèng tōngguò hòu kěyǐ guānbì zhège Bug dān.
terms.example_en: After verification passes, you can close this bug ticket.

terms.definition_en: Testing to ensure that new changes do not break existing functionality.
terms.definition_zh: 确保新变更不破坏现有功能的测试。
terms.example_zh: 每次发布前都要做回归测试。
terms.example_pinyin: Měi cì fābù qián dōu yào zuò huíguī cèshì.
terms.example_en: Regression testing must be done before every release.

terms.definition_en: A quick set of tests to verify basic functionality before deeper testing.
terms.definition_zh: 在深入测试前快速验证基本功能的一组测试。
terms.example_zh: 先跑一遍冒烟测试，确保主要功能正常。
terms.example_pinyin: Xiān pǎo yī biàn yānmào cèshì, quèbǎo zhǔyào gōngnéng zhèngcháng.
terms.example_en: Run a smoke test first to ensure major functions work.

terms.definition_en: Testing that verifies the interaction between integrated components.
terms.definition_zh: 验证集成组件之间交互的测试。
terms.example_zh: 集成测试需要模拟真实环境。
terms.example_pinyin: Jíchéng cèshì xūyào mónǐ zhēnshí huánjìng.
terms.example_en: Integration testing needs to simulate real environments.

terms.definition_en: End-to-end testing of the complete system against requirements.
terms.definition_zh: 对完整系统进行端到端测试以验证需求。
terms.example_zh: 系统测试包括性能、安全等非功能测试。
terms.example_pinyin: Xìtǒng cèshì bāokuò xìngnéng, ānquán děng fēi gōngnéng cèshì.
terms.example_en: System testing includes non-functional tests like performance and security.

terms.definition_en: A formal test to determine if a system meets the acceptance criteria and is ready for deployment.
terms.definition_zh: 确定系统是否满足验收标准并准备部署的正式测试。
terms.example_zh: 验收测试通过了，可以上线了。
terms.example_pinyin: Yànshōu cèshì tōngguò le, kěyǐ shàngxiàn le.
terms.example_en: The acceptance test passed, we can go live.

terms.definition_en: A test that verifies the correctness of a single unit of code, typically a function or method.
terms.definition_zh: 验证单个代码单元（通常是函数或方法）正确性的测试。
terms.example_zh: 每个函数都要写单元测试。
terms.example_pinyin: Měi gè hánshù dōu yào xiě dānyuán cèshì.
terms.example_en: Every function must have a unit test.

terms.definition_en: A test that validates the entire system flow from start to finish, simulating real user scenarios.
terms.definition_zh: 验证从开始到结束的整个系统流程的测试，模拟真实用户场景。
terms.example_zh: 端到端测试覆盖了所有关键路径。
terms.example_pinyin: Duān dào duān cèshì fùgài le suǒyǒu guānjiàn lùjìng.
terms.example_en: End-to-end tests cover all critical paths.

terms.definition_en: Testing performed by a human without automation tools.
terms.definition_zh: 由人工执行、不使用自动化工具的测试。
terms.example_zh: 手动测试太耗时了，我们考虑自动化。
terms.example_pinyin: Shǒudòng cèshì tài hào shí le, wǒmen kǎolǜ zìdònghuà.
terms.example_en: Manual testing is too time-consuming; we are considering automation.

terms.definition_en: Testing that uses software tools to execute test cases automatically and compare actual outcomes with expected results.
terms.definition_zh: 使用软件工具自动执行测试用例并将实际结果与预期结果进行比较的测试。
terms.example_zh: 自动化测试可以节省大量回归测试的时间。
terms.example_pinyin: Zìdònghuà cèshì kěyǐ jiéshěng dàliàng huíguī cèshì de shíjiān.
terms.example_en: Automated testing can save a lot of time on regression testing.

terms.definition_en: A set of instructions written in a programming language to automate test execution.
terms.definition_zh: 用编程语言编写的一组指令，用于自动化执行测试。
terms.example_zh: 这个测试脚本需要更新以适配新接口。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège cèshì jiǎoběn xūyào gēngxīn yǐ shìpèi xīn jiēkǒu.
terms.example_en: This test script needs to be updated to adapt to the new API.

terms.definition_en: A set of guidelines, tools, and libraries that provide a foundation for writing and running tests.
terms.definition_zh: 为编写和运行测试提供基础的一组指南、工具和库。
terms.example_zh: 我们选用Pytest作为测试框架。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xuǎnyòng Pytest zuòwéi cèshì kuàngjià.
terms.example_en: We choose Pytest as the test framework.

terms.definition_en: An environment or system that provides infrastructure for test execution, management, and reporting.
terms.definition_zh: 提供测试执行、管理和报告基础设施的环境或系统。
terms.example_zh: 测试平台支持并行执行多个测试用例。
terms.example_pinyin: Cèshì píngtái zhīchí bìngxíng zhíxíng duō gè cèshì yònglì.
terms.example_en: The test platform supports parallel execution of multiple test cases.

terms.definition_en: A metric that measures the percentage of code or functionality exercised by tests.
terms.definition_zh: 衡量测试所执行的代码或功能百分比的指标。
terms.example_zh: 我们的代码覆盖率目标是80%。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen de dàimǎ fùgài lǜ mùbiāo shì bāshí fēnzhī bǎi.
terms.example_en: Our code coverage target is 80%.

terms.definition_en: The percentage of test cases that pass out of the total executed.
terms.definition_zh: 通过的测试用例数占执行总数的百分比。
terms.example_zh: 本次测试的通过率是95%。
terms.example_pinyin: Běn cì cèshì de tōngguò lǜ shì jiǔshíwǔ fēnzhī bǎi.
terms.example_en: The pass rate for this test is 95%.

terms.definition_en: The percentage of test cases that fail out of the total executed.
terms.definition_zh: 失败的测试用例数占执行总数的百分比。
terms.example_zh: 失败率太高了，需要排查问题。
terms.example_pinyin: Shībài lǜ tài gāo le, xūyào páichá wèntí.
terms.example_en: The failure rate is too high; we need to investigate.

terms.definition_en: A defect or scenario that was not covered by the test suite and thus went undetected.
terms.definition_zh: 测试套件未覆盖因而未被发现的缺陷或场景。
terms.example_zh: 这个bug是漏测导致的。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège bug shì lòu cè dǎozhì de.
terms.example_en: This bug was caused by a missed test.

terms.definition_en: A test result that incorrectly indicates a defect when no actual defect exists.
terms.definition_zh: 错误地指示存在缺陷而实际没有缺陷的测试结果。
terms.example_zh: 这个告警是误报，忽略它。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège gàojǐng shì wùbào, hūlüè tā.
terms.example_en: This alert is a false positive; ignore it.

terms.definition_en: Conditions that must be met before a test phase can begin.
terms.definition_zh: 测试阶段开始前必须满足的条件。
terms.example_zh: 准入条件包括所有单元测试通过。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhǔnrù tiáojiàn bāokuò suǒyǒu dānyuán cèshì tōngguò.
terms.example_en: Entry criteria include all unit tests passing.

terms.definition_en: Conditions that must be met before a test phase can be considered complete.
terms.definition_zh: 测试阶段被认为完成前必须满足的条件。
terms.example_zh: 准出标准是零严重缺陷。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhǔnchū biāozhǔn shì líng yánzhòng quēxiàn.
terms.example_en: Exit criteria are zero critical defects.

terms.definition_en: A checkpoint in the CI/CD pipeline that enforces quality standards before proceeding to the next stage.
terms.definition_zh: CI/CD流水线中的检查点，在进入下一阶段前强制执行质量标准。
terms.example_zh: 质量门禁失败，构建被阻止。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhìliàng ménjìn shībài, gòujiàn bèi zǔzhǐ.
terms.example_en: The quality gate failed, blocking the build.

terms.definition_en: Data used as input to test cases, often prepared specifically for testing purposes.
terms.definition_zh: 用作测试用例输入的数据，通常为测试目的专门准备。
terms.example_zh: 我们需要准备一批测试数据。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zhǔnbèi yī pī cèshì shùjù.
terms.example_en: We need to prepare a batch of test data.

terms.definition_en: The process of creating test data, often using scripts or tools to generate realistic data sets.
terms.definition_zh: 创建测试数据的过程，通常使用脚本或工具生成真实数据集。
terms.example_zh: 造数脚本已经写好了。
terms.example_pinyin: Zào shù jiǎoběn yǐjīng xiě hǎo le.
terms.example_en: The data generation script is ready.

terms.definition_en: Simulated data that mimics real data, used to isolate the system under test from external dependencies.
terms.definition_zh: 模拟真实数据的仿真数据，用于将被测系统与外部依赖隔离。
terms.example_zh: 用Mock数据模拟第三方接口返回。
terms.example_pinyin: Yòng Mock shùjù mónǐ dìsānfāng jiēkǒu fǎnhuí.
terms.example_en: Use mock data to simulate third-party API responses.

terms.definition_en: A minimal implementation of a component that returns predefined responses, used for testing.
terms.definition_zh: 组件的最小实现，返回预定义响应，用于测试。
terms.example_zh: 这个桩函数返回固定值。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège zhuāng hánshù fǎnhuí gùdìng zhí.
terms.example_en: This stub function returns a fixed value.

terms.definition_en: An object that simulates the behavior of a real object, often used to verify interactions.
terms.definition_zh: 模拟真实对象行为的对象，常用于验证交互。
terms.example_zh: 用替身对象验证调用次数。
terms.example_pinyin: Yòng tìshēn duìxiàng yànzhèng diàoyòng cìshù.
terms.example_en: Use a mock object to verify the number of calls.

terms.definition_en: A standard or point of reference against which performance or quality can be measured.
terms.definition_zh: 用于衡量性能或质量的标准或参考点。
terms.example_zh: 我们需要设定性能基准。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào shèdìng xìngnéng jīzhǔn.
terms.example_en: We need to set a performance benchmark.

terms.definition_en: Testing to determine the responsiveness, throughput, and stability of a system under a particular workload.
terms.definition_zh: 确定系统在特定工作负载下的响应性、吞吐量和稳定性的测试。
terms.example_zh: 性能测试显示响应时间在可接受范围内。
terms.example_pinyin: Xìngnéng cèshì xiǎnshì xiǎngyìng shíjiān zài kě jiēshòu fànwéi nèi.
terms.example_en: Performance tests show response times are within acceptable limits.

terms.definition_en: Testing to evaluate how a system behaves under extreme conditions, often beyond normal operational capacity.
terms.definition_zh: 评估系统在极端条件下（通常超出正常运营能力）行为的测试。
terms.example_zh: 压力测试发现系统在并发1000用户时崩溃。
terms.example_pinyin: Yālì cèshì fāxiàn xìtǒng zài bìngfā yīqiān yònghù shí bēngkuì.
terms.example_en: Stress tests revealed the system crashes under 1000 concurrent users.

terms.definition_en: Testing to measure system performance under expected normal and peak load conditions.
terms.definition_zh: 在预期正常和峰值负载条件下测量系统性能的测试。
terms.example_zh: 负载测试模拟了双十一的流量。
terms.example_pinyin: Fùzài cèshì mónǐ le Shuāng Shíyī de liúliàng.
terms.example_en: Load tests simulated the traffic of Singles' Day.

terms.definition_en: A test to verify that a system remains stable under various conditions over time.
terms.definition_zh: 验证系统在各种条件下长时间保持稳定的测试。
terms.example_zh: 这个版本需要先通过稳定性测试才能发布。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège bǎnběn xūyào xiān tōngguò wěndìngxìng cèshì cáinéng fābù.
terms.example_en: This version must pass the stability test before release.

terms.definition_en: A prolonged stability test, typically lasting days or weeks, to uncover intermittent issues.
terms.definition_zh: 持续数天或数周的稳定性测试，用于发现间歇性问题。
terms.example_zh: 长稳测试跑了两天，没有发现异常。
terms.example_pinyin: Cháng wěn cèshì pǎo le liǎng tiān, méiyǒu fāxiàn yìcháng.
terms.example_en: The long stability test ran for two days with no anomalies found.

terms.definition_en: The ability of a system to perform its required functions under stated conditions for a specified period.
terms.definition_zh: 系统在规定条件下和时间内执行所需功能的能力。
terms.example_zh: 车载系统的可靠性直接影响驾驶安全。
terms.example_pinyin: Chēzài xìtǒng de kěkào xìng zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng jiàshǐ ānquán.
terms.example_en: The reliability of the in-vehicle system directly affects driving safety.

terms.definition_en: The proportion of time a system is in a functioning condition, often measured as uptime percentage.
terms.definition_zh: 系统处于正常运行状态的时间比例，通常用正常运行时间百分比衡量。
terms.example_zh: 我们的目标是达到99.9%的可用性。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen de mùbiāo shì dádào 99.9% de kěyòng xìng.
terms.example_en: Our goal is to achieve 99.9% availability.

terms.definition_en: The overall experience and satisfaction a user has when interacting with a product or system.
terms.definition_zh: 用户在使用产品或系统时的整体体验和满意度。
terms.example_zh: 这次更新主要优化了用户体验。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhè cì gēngxīn zhǔyào yōuhuà le yònghù tǐyàn.
terms.example_en: This update mainly improves the user experience.

terms.definition_en: The ease with which a user can learn and use a system to achieve their goals effectively.
terms.definition_zh: 用户学习和使用系统有效达成目标的容易程度。
terms.example_zh: 这个界面的易用性还需要改进。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège jièmiàn de yìyòng xìng hái xūyào gǎijìn.
terms.example_en: The usability of this interface still needs improvement.

terms.definition_en: Testing to ensure a system works correctly with different hardware, software, or network environments.
terms.definition_zh: 确保系统在不同硬件、软件或网络环境下正常工作的测试。
terms.example_zh: 我们需要在多种车型上进行兼容性测试。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zài duō zhǒng chēxíng shàng jìnxíng jiānróng xìng cèshì.
terms.example_en: We need to run compatibility tests on multiple car models.

terms.definition_en: A testing framework for automating UI interactions on Android devices.
terms.definition_zh: 用于在Android设备上自动化UI交互的测试框架。
terms.example_zh: 我们用UI自动化工具来回归测试。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yòng UI zìdònghuà gōngjù lái huíguī cèshì.
terms.example_en: We use UI Automator for regression testing.

terms.definition_en: A testing framework for writing concise UI tests for Android apps.
terms.definition_zh: 用于为Android应用编写简洁UI测试的框架。
terms.example_zh: Espresso框架让UI测试更稳定。
terms.example_pinyin: Espresso kuàngjià ràng UI cèshì gèng wěndìng.
terms.example_en: The Espresso framework makes UI tests more stable.

terms.definition_en: A random event generator test for Android apps to find crashes or errors.
terms.definition_zh: 一种为Android应用生成随机事件的测试，用于发现崩溃或错误。
terms.example_zh: Monkey测试跑了一晚上，没有发现崩溃。
terms.example_pinyin: Monkey cèshì pǎo le yī wǎnshàng, méiyǒu fāxiàn bēngkuì.
terms.example_en: The Monkey test ran all night with no crashes found.

terms.definition_en: The setup of hardware, software, and network conditions used for testing.
terms.definition_zh: 用于测试的硬件、软件和网络条件的配置。
terms.example_zh: 请确保测试环境与生产环境一致。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng quèbǎo cèshì huánjìng yǔ shēngchǎn huánjìng yīzhì.
terms.example_en: Please ensure the test environment is consistent with the production environment.

terms.definition_en: A physical or virtual platform where tests are executed, often including instruments and fixtures.
terms.definition_zh: 执行测试的物理或虚拟平台，通常包含仪器和夹具。
terms.example_zh: 我们在测试台上验证了CAN总线通信。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zài cèshì tái shàng yànzhèng le CAN zǒngxiàn tōngxìn.
terms.example_en: We verified CAN bus communication on the test bed.

terms.definition_en: Formal approval indicating that a product or phase is complete and meets requirements.
terms.definition_zh: 正式批准，表明产品或阶段已完成并符合要求。
terms.example_zh: 测试通过后需要项目经理签字确认。
terms.example_pinyin: Cèshì tōngguò hòu xūyào xiàngmù jīnglǐ qiānzì quèrèn.
terms.example_en: After the test passes, the project manager needs to sign off.

terms.definition_en: Relating to systems or devices installed in a vehicle.
terms.definition_zh: 与安装在车辆中的系统或设备相关的。
terms.example_zh: 车载娱乐系统需要支持多种音源。
terms.example_pinyin: Chēzài yúlè xìtǒng xūyào zhīchí duō zhǒng yīnyuán.
terms.example_en: The in-vehicle infotainment system needs to support multiple audio sources.

terms.definition_en: The central control unit in a vehicle's dashboard that manages audio, navigation, and other functions.
terms.definition_zh: 车辆仪表板中的中央控制单元，管理音频、导航等功能。
terms.example_zh: 车机系统升级后，导航反应更快了。
terms.example_pinyin: Chē jī xìtǒng shēngjí hòu, dǎoháng fǎnyìng gèng kuài le.
terms.example_en: After the head unit system upgrade, the navigation responds faster.

terms.definition_en: The interior space of a vehicle where the driver and passengers sit, including controls and displays.
terms.definition_zh: 车辆内部驾驶员和乘客乘坐的空间，包括控制和显示设备。
terms.example_zh: 智能座舱集成了语音控制和手势识别。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhìnéng zuòcāng jíchéng le yǔyīn kòngzhì hé shǒushì shìbié.
terms.example_en: The smart cockpit integrates voice control and gesture recognition.

terms.definition_en: A combination of information and entertainment services provided by in-vehicle systems.
terms.definition_zh: 车载系统提供的信息和娱乐服务的组合。
terms.example_zh: 信息娱乐系统包括导航、音乐和视频功能。
terms.example_pinyin: Xìnxī yúlè xìtǒng bāokuò dǎoháng, yīnyuè hé shìpín gōngnéng.
terms.example_en: The infotainment system includes navigation, music, and video functions.

terms.definition_en: In-Vehicle Infotainment system that provides entertainment and information to vehicle occupants.
terms.definition_zh: 为车辆乘员提供娱乐和信息服务的车载系统。
terms.example_zh: IVI系统需要支持CarPlay和Android Auto。
terms.example_pinyin: IVI xìtǒng xūyào zhīchí CarPlay hé Android Auto.
terms.example_en: The IVI system needs to support CarPlay and Android Auto.

terms.definition_en: The display panel in front of the driver showing speed, fuel level, and other vehicle information.
terms.definition_zh: 驾驶员前方的显示面板，显示速度、油量等车辆信息。
terms.example_zh: 仪表盘上显示了一个警告灯。
terms.example_pinyin: Yíbiǎo pán shàng xiǎnshì le yī gè jǐnggào dēng.
terms.example_en: A warning light is displayed on the instrument cluster.

terms.definition_en: The central touchscreen display in a vehicle's dashboard used for controlling infotainment and settings.
terms.definition_zh: 车辆仪表板中央的触摸屏显示器，用于控制信息娱乐和设置。
terms.example_zh: 中控屏的响应速度需要优化。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhōngkòng píng de xiǎngyìng sùdù xūyào yōuhuà.
terms.example_en: The response speed of the center screen needs optimization.

terms.definition_en: A large display screen, typically in a vehicle, used for navigation, entertainment, or information.
terms.definition_zh: 车辆中的大尺寸显示屏，用于导航、娱乐或信息显示。
terms.example_zh: 大屏设计让导航地图更清晰。
terms.example_pinyin: Dàpíng shèjì ràng dǎoháng dìtú gèng qīngxī.
terms.example_en: The large screen design makes the navigation map clearer.

terms.definition_en: A system that provides route guidance and location information to a driver.
terms.definition_zh: 为驾驶员提供路线指引和位置信息的系统。
terms.example_zh: 导航系统需要实时更新交通信息。
terms.example_pinyin: Dǎoháng xìtǒng xūyào shíshí gēngxīn jiāotōng xìnxī.
terms.example_en: The navigation system needs real-time traffic updates.

terms.definition_en: A technology that allows users to control a system using spoken commands.
terms.definition_zh: 允许用户通过语音命令控制系统的技术。
terms.example_zh: 语音控制可以免提拨打电话。
terms.example_pinyin: Yǔyīn kòngzhì kěyǐ miǎntí bōdǎ diànhuà.
terms.example_en: Voice control allows hands-free calling.

terms.definition_en: A wireless technology standard for exchanging data over short distances between devices.
terms.definition_zh: 一种短距离设备间数据交换的无线技术标准。
terms.example_zh: 蓝牙连接不稳定，需要排查。
terms.example_pinyin: Lányá liánjiē bù wěndìng, xūyào páichá.
terms.example_en: The Bluetooth connection is unstable and needs troubleshooting.

terms.definition_en: A robust vehicle bus standard designed for communication between electronic control units (ECUs).
terms.definition_zh: 一种为电子控制单元（ECU）之间通信设计的稳健车辆总线标准。
terms.example_zh: CAN总线用于传输车辆状态信息。
terms.example_pinyin: CAN zǒngxiàn yòng yú chuánshū chēliàng zhuàngtài xìnxī.
terms.example_en: The CAN bus is used to transmit vehicle status information.

terms.definition_en: A widely used local area network technology for connecting devices.
terms.definition_zh: 一种广泛使用的局域网技术，用于连接设备。
terms.example_zh: 车载以太网用于高速数据传输。
terms.example_pinyin: Chēzài yǐtài wǎng yòng yú gāosù shùjù chuánshū.
terms.example_en: In-vehicle Ethernet is used for high-speed data transmission.

terms.definition_en: An embedded system that controls one or more electrical systems in a vehicle.
terms.definition_zh: 控制车辆中一个或多个电气系统的嵌入式系统。
terms.example_zh: ECU负责发动机控制。
terms.example_pinyin: ECU fùzé fādòngjī kòngzhì.
terms.example_en: The ECU is responsible for engine control.

terms.definition_en: A centralized computing unit that manages multiple ECUs in a specific domain.
terms.definition_zh: 管理特定域中多个ECU的集中式计算单元。
terms.example_zh: 域控制器整合了多个ECU的功能。
terms.example_pinyin: Yù kòngzhì qì zhěnghé le duō gè ECU de gōngnéng.
terms.example_en: The domain controller integrates the functions of multiple ECUs.

terms.definition_en: Technology that enables a vehicle to operate without human intervention.
terms.definition_zh: 使车辆无需人工干预即可运行的技术。
terms.example_zh: 自动驾驶系统需要高精度地图。
terms.example_pinyin: Zìdòng jiàshǐ xìtǒng xūyào gāo jīngdù dìtú.
terms.example_en: Autonomous driving systems require high-precision maps.

terms.definition_en: Driver assistance features that help but do not replace the driver.
terms.definition_zh: 帮助驾驶员但不替代驾驶员的辅助功能。
terms.example_zh: 辅助驾驶功能包括自适应巡航。
terms.example_pinyin: Fǔzhù jiàshǐ gōngnéng bāokuò zìshìyìng xúnháng.
terms.example_en: Assisted driving features include adaptive cruise control.

terms.definition_en: Systems that enhance vehicle safety and driving comfort through automation.
terms.definition_zh: 通过自动化提高车辆安全和驾驶舒适性的系统。
terms.example_zh: ADAS系统需要多种传感器融合。
terms.example_pinyin: ADAS xìtǒng xūyào duō zhǒng chuángǎnqì rónghé.
terms.example_en: ADAS systems require multi-sensor fusion.

terms.definition_en: A device that detects and responds to physical inputs from the environment.
terms.definition_zh: 检测并响应环境物理输入的设备。
terms.example_zh: 传感器数据用于环境感知。
terms.example_pinyin: Chuángǎnqì shùjù yòng yú huánjìng gǎnzhī.
terms.example_en: Sensor data is used for environmental perception.

terms.definition_en: A detection system that uses radio waves to determine range and speed.
terms.definition_zh: 使用无线电波确定距离和速度的探测系统。
terms.example_zh: 毫米波雷达用于目标检测。
terms.example_pinyin: Háomǐbō léidá yòng yú mùbiāo jiǎncè.
terms.example_en: Millimeter-wave radar is used for object detection.

terms.definition_en: A remote sensing method using laser light to measure distances.
terms.definition_zh: 使用激光测量距离的遥感方法。
terms.example_zh: 激光雷达生成点云数据。
terms.example_pinyin: Jīguāng léidá shēngchéng diǎnyún shùjù.
terms.example_en: LiDAR generates point cloud data.

terms.definition_en: An optical device that captures visual images for processing.
terms.definition_zh: 捕获视觉图像以供处理的光学设备。
terms.example_zh: 摄像头用于车道线检测。
terms.example_pinyin: Shèxiàngtóu yòng yú chēdào xiàn jiǎncè.
terms.example_en: Cameras are used for lane detection.

terms.definition_en: Combining data from multiple sensors to improve accuracy and reliability.
terms.definition_zh: 结合多个传感器的数据以提高准确性和可靠性。
terms.example_zh: 传感器融合算法融合雷达和摄像头数据。
terms.example_pinyin: Chuángǎnqì rónghé suànfǎ rónghé léidá hé shèxiàngtóu shùjù.
terms.example_en: Sensor fusion algorithms combine radar and camera data.

terms.definition_en: The process of interpreting sensor data to understand the environment.
terms.definition_zh: 解释传感器数据以理解环境的过程。
terms.example_zh: 感知模块识别行人。
terms.example_pinyin: Gǎnzhī mókuài shìbié xíngrén.
terms.example_en: The perception module identifies pedestrians.

terms.definition_en: The process of selecting actions based on perception and planning.
terms.definition_zh: 基于感知和规划选择行动的过程。
terms.example_zh: 决策模块决定是否变道。
terms.example_pinyin: Juécè mókuài juédìng shìfǒu biàndào.
terms.example_en: The decision-making module decides whether to change lanes.

terms.definition_en: The act of managing vehicle dynamics to execute planned actions.
terms.definition_zh: 管理车辆动力学以执行计划动作的行为。
terms.example_zh: 控制算法输出转向和制动指令。
terms.example_pinyin: Kòngzhì suànfǎ shūchū zhuǎnxiàng hé zhìdòng zhǐlìng.
terms.example_en: The control algorithm outputs steering and braking commands.

terms.definition_en: Generating a safe and efficient path or trajectory for the vehicle.
terms.definition_zh: 为车辆生成安全高效的路径或轨迹。
terms.example_zh: 规划模块生成行驶轨迹。
terms.example_pinyin: Guīhuà mókuài shēngchéng xíngshǐ guǐjì.
terms.example_en: The planning module generates a driving trajectory.

terms.definition_en: The process of adjusting sensor parameters to ensure accuracy.
terms.definition_zh: 调整传感器参数以确保准确性的过程。
terms.example_zh: 摄像头需要定期标定。
terms.example_pinyin: Shèxiàngtóu xūyào dìngqī biāodìng.
terms.example_en: Cameras need regular calibration.

terms.definition_en: Identifying and analyzing faults in vehicle systems.
terms.definition_zh: 识别和分析车辆系统故障。
terms.example_zh: 诊断工具读取故障码。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhěnduàn gōngjù dúqǔ gùzhàng mǎ.
terms.example_en: Diagnostic tools read fault codes.

terms.definition_en: A standardized interface for accessing vehicle diagnostic data.
terms.definition_zh: 用于访问车辆诊断数据的标准化接口。
terms.example_zh: OBD接口用于排放检测。
terms.example_pinyin: OBD jiēkǒu yòng yú páifàng jiǎncè.
terms.example_en: The OBD port is used for emissions testing.

terms.definition_en: Updating firmware or software in an ECU via reprogramming.
terms.definition_zh: 通过重新编程更新ECU中的固件或软件。
terms.example_zh: 我们需要刷新ECU固件。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào shuāxīn ECU gùjiàn.
terms.example_en: We need to flash the ECU firmware.

terms.definition_en: Wireless delivery of software updates to vehicles over the air.
terms.definition_zh: 通过无线方式向车辆推送软件更新。
terms.example_zh: OTA升级修复了安全漏洞。
terms.example_pinyin: OTA shēngjí xiūfù le ānquán lòudòng.
terms.example_en: The OTA update fixed a security vulnerability.

terms.definition_en: Operation or access from a distance, often via wireless communication.
terms.definition_zh: 通过无线通信从远处进行操作或访问。
terms.example_zh: 远程诊断功能可以节省时间。
terms.example_pinyin: Yuǎnchéng zhěnduàn gōngnéng kěyǐ jiéshěng shíjiān.
terms.example_en: Remote diagnostics can save time.

terms.definition_en: Absence of unreasonable risk due to hazards caused by malfunctioning systems.
terms.definition_zh: 因系统故障导致危险的不合理风险不存在。
terms.example_zh: 功能安全标准ISO 26262。
terms.example_pinyin: Gōngnéng ānquán biāozhǔn ISO 26262.
terms.example_en: Functional safety standard ISO 26262.

terms.definition_en: Safety from unintended behavior of intended functions, especially in autonomous systems.
terms.definition_zh: 预期功能中非预期行为导致的安全问题，尤其在自动驾驶系统中。
terms.example_zh: SOTIF标准ISO 21448。
terms.example_pinyin: SOTIF biāozhǔn ISO 21448.
terms.example_en: SOTIF standard ISO 21448.

terms.definition_en: Protection of vehicle networks and systems from digital attacks.
terms.definition_zh: 保护车辆网络和系统免受数字攻击。
terms.example_zh: 网络安全是智能汽车的关键。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǎngluò ānquán shì zhìnéng qìchē de guānjiàn.
terms.example_en: Cybersecurity is critical for smart vehicles.

terms.definition_en: Protection of data confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
terms.definition_zh: 保护数据的机密性、完整性和可用性。
terms.example_zh: 信息安全策略防止数据泄露。
terms.example_pinyin: Xìnxī ānquán cèlüè fángzhǐ shùjù xièlòu.
terms.example_en: Information security policies prevent data leaks.

terms.definition_en: Technology that combines telecommunications and informatics for vehicle communication and monitoring.
terms.definition_zh: 结合电信和信息处理技术，用于车辆通信和监控的技术。
terms.example_zh: 远程信息处理模块需要支持OTA升级。
terms.example_pinyin: Yuǎnchéng xìnxī chǔlǐ mókuài xūyào zhīchí OTA shēngjí.
terms.example_en: The telematics module needs to support OTA updates.

terms.definition_en: Vehicle-to-everything communication enabling interaction with other vehicles, infrastructure, and networks.
terms.definition_zh: 车辆与外界通信的技术，实现车与车、基础设施、网络等的交互。
terms.example_zh: V2X技术可以提升自动驾驶的安全性。
terms.example_pinyin: V2X jìshù kěyǐ tíshēng zìdòng jiàshǐ de ānquán xìng.
terms.example_en: V2X technology can improve the safety of autonomous driving.

terms.definition_en: A virtual key stored on a mobile device that allows keyless entry and start of a vehicle.
terms.definition_zh: 存储在移动设备上的虚拟钥匙，用于无钥匙进入和启动车辆。
terms.example_zh: 数字钥匙功能需要蓝牙和NFC支持。
terms.example_pinyin: Shùzì yàoshi gōngnéng xūyào lányá hé NFC zhīchí.
terms.example_en: The digital key feature requires Bluetooth and NFC support.

terms.definition_en: Biometric technology that identifies or verifies a person from a digital image or video frame.
terms.definition_zh: 通过数字图像或视频帧识别或验证个人身份的生物识别技术。
terms.example_zh: 人脸识别系统在低光照条件下表现不佳。
terms.example_pinyin: Rénliǎn shíbié xìtǒng zài dī guāngzhào tiáojiàn xià biǎoxiàn bù jiā.
terms.example_en: The face recognition system performs poorly under low-light conditions.

terms.definition_en: Technology that interprets human gestures via sensors to control devices without physical contact.
terms.definition_zh: 通过传感器解读人体手势，实现无接触控制设备的技术。
terms.example_zh: 手势控制功能在驾驶时可以减少分心。
terms.example_pinyin: Shǒushì kòngzhì gōngnéng zài jiàshǐ shí kěyǐ jiǎnshǎo fēnxīn.
terms.example_en: Gesture control can reduce distraction while driving.

terms.definition_en: User interface that connects a person to a machine, system, or device.
terms.definition_zh: 连接人与机器、系统或设备的用户界面。
terms.example_zh: HMI设计需要符合人体工程学。
terms.example_pinyin: HMI shèjì xūyào fúhé réntǐ gōngchéngxué.
terms.example_en: HMI design must comply with ergonomics.

terms.definition_en: International standard for functional safety of electrical and electronic systems in road vehicles.
terms.definition_zh: 道路车辆电气/电子系统功能安全的国际标准。
terms.example_zh: 该项目必须通过ISO 26262认证。
terms.example_pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù bìxū tōngguò ISO 26262 rènzhèng.
terms.example_en: The project must pass ISO 26262 certification.

terms.definition_en: Automotive SPICE, a process assessment model for software development in the automotive industry.
terms.definition_zh: 汽车行业软件开发的流程评估模型。
terms.example_zh: ASPICE等级达到L3才能交付。
terms.example_pinyin: ASPICE děngjí dádào L3 cáinéng jiāofù.
terms.example_en: Delivery requires an ASPICE level of L3.

terms.pinyin: jiān róng xìng dìng yì wén dàng
terms.definition_en: Compatibility Definition Document outlining requirements for Android device compatibility.
terms.definition_zh: 定义Android设备兼容性要求的文档。
terms.example_zh: CDD中明确了硬件要求。
terms.example_pinyin: CDD zhōng míngquèle yìngjiàn yāoqiú.
terms.example_en: The CDD specifies hardware requirements.

terms.pinyin: jiān róng xìng cèshì tào jiàn
terms.definition_en: Compatibility Test Suite, a set of tests to verify Android device compatibility.
terms.definition_zh: 用于验证Android设备兼容性的测试套件。
terms.example_zh: CTS测试必须在所有设备上通过。
terms.example_pinyin: CTS cèshì bìxū zài suǒyǒu shèbèi shàng tōngguò.
terms.example_en: CTS tests must pass on all devices.

terms.definition_en: Google Mobile Services, a collection of Google apps and APIs for Android devices.
terms.definition_zh: 谷歌为Android设备提供的应用和API集合。
terms.example_zh: 预装GMS需要谷歌授权。
terms.example_pinyin: Yùzhuāng GMS xūyào Gǔgē shòuquán.
terms.example_en: Pre-installing GMS requires Google authorization.

terms.definition_en: Vendor Test Suite, tests for verifying vendor implementation of Android.
terms.definition_zh: 用于验证供应商Android实现的测试套件。
terms.example_zh: VTS测试覆盖了内核和HAL层。
terms.example_pinyin: VTS cèshì fùgàile nèihé hé HAL céng.
terms.example_en: VTS tests cover the kernel and HAL layers.

terms.definition_en: Google Test Suite, tests for verifying Google Mobile Services compatibility.
terms.definition_zh: 用于验证谷歌移动服务兼容性的测试套件。
terms.example_zh: GTS测试失败需要立即修复。
terms.example_pinyin: GTS cèshì shībài xūyào lìjí xiūfù.
terms.example_en: GTS test failures must be fixed immediately.

terms.definition_en: Security Test Suite, tests for verifying Android security requirements.
terms.definition_zh: 用于验证Android安全要求的测试套件。
terms.example_zh: STS测试确保设备符合安全标准。
terms.example_pinyin: STS cèshì quèbǎo shèbèi fúhé ānquán biāozhǔn.
terms.example_en: STS tests ensure devices meet security standards.

terms.definition_en: Formal process of verifying that a product meets specified requirements.
terms.definition_zh: 验证产品符合规定要求的正式过程。
terms.example_zh: 产品上市前必须通过认证。
terms.example_pinyin: Chǎnpǐn shàngshì qián bìxū tōngguò rènzhèng.
terms.example_en: Products must pass certification before launch.

terms.definition_en: Adherence to laws, regulations, guidelines, and specifications.
terms.definition_zh: 遵守法律、法规、指南和规范。
terms.example_zh: 合规检查是项目里程碑之一。
terms.example_pinyin: Hégūi jiǎnchá shì xiàngmù lǐchéngbēi zhī yī.
terms.example_en: Compliance check is one of the project milestones.

terms.definition_en: A condition or capability needed by a user to solve a problem or achieve an objective.
terms.definition_zh: 用户解决问题或达成目标所需的条件或能力。
terms.example_zh: 需求文档中明确了功能要求。
terms.example_pinyin: Xūqiú wéndàng zhōng míngquèle gōngnéng yāoqiú.
terms.example_en: The requirements document specifies functional requirements.

terms.definition_en: A detailed description of the design and materials used to make something.
terms.definition_zh: 对设计和使用材料的详细描述。
terms.example_zh: 接口规范需要团队评审。
terms.example_pinyin: Jiēkǒu guīfàn xūyào tuánduì píngshěn.
terms.example_en: The interface specification needs team review.

terms.definition_en: A level of quality or achievement that is considered acceptable or desirable.
terms.definition_zh: 被认为可接受或理想的质量或成就水平。
terms.example_zh: 编码标准必须严格遵守。
terms.example_pinyin: Biānmǎ biāozhǔn bìxū yángé zūnshǒu.
terms.example_en: Coding standards must be strictly followed.

terms.definition_en: Specific conditions that must be met for a test or process to be considered successful.
terms.definition_zh: 测试或过程被认为成功必须满足的具体条件。
terms.example_zh: 通过标准包括所有测试用例通过。
terms.example_pinyin: Tōngguò biāozhǔn bāokuò suǒyǒu cèshì yònglì tōngguò.
terms.example_en: Pass criteria include all test cases passing.

terms.definition_en: Specific conditions that cause a test or process to be considered unsuccessful.
terms.definition_zh: 导致测试或过程被认为不成功的具体条件。
terms.example_zh: 任何严重缺陷都视为失败标准。
terms.example_pinyin: Rènhé yánzhòng quēxiàn dōu shì wéi shībài biāozhǔn.
terms.example_en: Any critical defect is considered a fail criterion.

terms.definition_en: A process where a system or component checks its own status or functionality.
terms.definition_zh: 系统或组件检查自身状态或功能的过程。
terms.example_zh: 开机自检可以检测硬件故障。
terms.example_pinyin: Kāijī zìjiǎn kěyǐ jiǎncè yìngjiàn gùzhàng.
terms.example_en: Power-on self-check can detect hardware faults.

terms.definition_en: Certification performed by an independent organization not involved in the product's development.
terms.definition_zh: 由独立于产品开发的机构进行的认证。
terms.example_zh: 第三方认证增加了产品可信度。
terms.example_pinyin: Dì sān fāng rènzhèng zēngjiāle chǎnpǐn kěxìndù.
terms.example_en: Third-party certification increases product credibility.

terms.definition_en: Certification performed by the manufacturer itself, declaring compliance with standards.
terms.definition_zh: 制造商自行进行的认证，声明符合标准。
terms.example_zh: 自我认证适用于低风险产品。
terms.example_pinyin: Zìwǒ rènzhèng shìyòng yú dī fēngxiǎn chǎnpǐn.
terms.example_en: Self-certification applies to low-risk products.

terms.definition_en: An organization that conducts certification audits and issues certificates.
terms.definition_zh: 进行认证审核并颁发证书的组织。
terms.example_zh: 认证机构需要获得认可。
terms.example_pinyin: Rènzhèng jīgòu xūyào huòdé rènkě.
terms.example_en: Certification bodies need to be accredited.

terms.definition_en: A controlled environment for testing software or hardware.
terms.definition_zh: 用于测试软件或硬件的受控环境。
terms.example_zh: 测试实验室的环境需要与生产环境一致。
terms.example_pinyin: Cèshì shíyàn shì de huánjìng xūyào yǔ shēngchǎn huánjìng yīzhì.
terms.example_en: The test lab environment needs to be consistent with the production environment.

terms.definition_en: A systematic review of processes or records to ensure compliance.
terms.definition_zh: 对流程或记录进行系统性检查以确保合规。
terms.example_zh: 代码审核需要在合并前完成。
terms.example_pinyin: Dàimǎ shěnhé xūyào zài hébìng qián wánchéng.
terms.example_en: Code audit needs to be completed before merging.

terms.definition_en: A random inspection of a subset of items to verify quality.
terms.definition_zh: 随机检查部分项目以验证质量。
terms.example_zh: 我们每周会抽查一些日志文件。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen měi zhōu huì chōuchá yīxiē rìzhì wénjiàn.
terms.example_en: We spot check some log files every week.

terms.definition_en: Permission to be excused from a requirement or rule.
terms.definition_zh: 被允许免除某项要求或规则。
terms.example_zh: 这个安全漏洞获得了临时豁免。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège ānquán lòudòng huòdéle línshí huòmiǎn.
terms.example_en: This security vulnerability received a temporary exemption.

terms.definition_en: Voluntary relinquishment of a known right or privilege.
terms.definition_zh: 自愿放弃已知的权利或特权。
terms.example_zh: 他签署了责任弃权书。
terms.example_pinyin: Tā qiānshǔle zérèn qìquán shū.
terms.example_en: He signed a liability waiver.

terms.definition_en: A specific provision or condition in a document.
terms.definition_zh: 文档中的具体规定或条件。
terms.example_zh: 合同中的保密条款需要严格遵守。
terms.example_pinyin: Hétóng zhōng de bǎomì tiáokuǎn xūyào yángé zūnshǒu.
terms.example_en: The confidentiality clause in the contract must be strictly followed.

terms.definition_en: Indicates an absolute requirement in specifications.
terms.definition_zh: 表示规范中的绝对要求。
terms.example_zh: 所有密码必须加密存储。
terms.example_pinyin: Suǒyǒu mìmǎ bìxū jiāmì cúnchǔ.
terms.example_en: All passwords MUST be encrypted.

terms.definition_en: Indicates a recommended practice, not mandatory.
terms.definition_zh: 表示推荐做法，非强制。
terms.example_zh: 你应该在提交前运行单元测试。
terms.example_pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi zài tíjiāo qián yùnxíng dānyuán cèshì.
terms.example_en: You SHOULD run unit tests before committing.

terms.definition_en: Indicates permission or option, not required.
terms.definition_zh: 表示允许或选择，非必须。
terms.example_zh: 你可以选择使用任何框架。
terms.example_pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xuǎnzé shǐyòng rènhé kuàngjià.
terms.example_en: You MAY choose any framework.

terms.definition_en: Adherence to specified standards or requirements.
terms.definition_zh: 符合指定的标准或要求。
terms.example_zh: 产品需要满足一致性测试。
terms.example_pinyin: Chǎnpǐn xūyào mǎnzú yīzhì xìng cèshì.
terms.example_en: The product needs to pass conformance testing.

terms.definition_en: Failure to meet specified requirements.
terms.definition_zh: 未能满足指定的要求。
terms.example_zh: 这个模块存在不一致问题。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège mókuài cúnzài bù yīzhì wèntí.
terms.example_en: This module has a non-conformance issue.

terms.definition_en: A departure from the expected or standard behavior.
terms.definition_zh: 偏离预期或标准行为。
terms.example_zh: 性能测试结果有5%的偏差。
terms.example_pinyin: Xìngnéng cèshì jiéguǒ yǒu bǎi fēn zhī wǔ de piānchā.
terms.example_en: The performance test results have a 5% deviation.

terms.definition_en: The action of correcting a problem or deficiency.
terms.definition_zh: 纠正问题或缺陷的行动。
terms.example_zh: 安全漏洞需要立即整改。
terms.example_pinyin: Ānquán lòudòng xūyào lìjí zhěnggǎi.
terms.example_en: Security vulnerabilities require immediate remediation.

terms.definition_en: A daily short meeting where team members discuss progress.
terms.definition_zh: 每日简短会议，团队成员讨论进展。
terms.example_zh: 站会通常在早上9点开始。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhàn huì tōngcháng zài zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn kāishǐ.
terms.example_en: The standup usually starts at 9 AM.

terms.definition_en: A meeting held at the start of the workday to align the team.
terms.definition_zh: 工作日开始时举行的会议，用于团队对齐。
terms.example_zh: 晨会时间控制在15分钟内。
terms.example_pinyin: Chén huì shíjiān kòngzhì zài shíwǔ fēn zhōng nèi.
terms.example_en: The morning meeting is kept within 15 minutes.

terms.definition_en: A scheduled recurring meeting for routine updates.
terms.definition_zh: 定期召开的例行会议。
terms.example_zh: 每周一的例会讨论项目进度。
terms.example_pinyin: Měi zhōu yī de lìhuì tǎolùn xiàngmù jìndù.
terms.example_en: The regular meeting on Mondays discusses project progress.

terms.definition_en: A meeting to evaluate work products or decisions.
terms.definition_zh: 评估工作成果或决策的会议。
terms.example_zh: 代码评审会需要全体开发人员参加。
terms.example_pinyin: Dàimǎ píngshěn huì xūyào quántǐ kāifā rényuán cānjiā.
terms.example_en: All developers need to attend the code review meeting.

terms.definition_en: A meeting at the end of an iteration to reflect and improve.
terms.definition_zh: 迭代结束时举行的反思和改进会议。
terms.example_zh: 回顾会上我们总结了本次迭代的不足。
terms.example_pinyin: Huígù huì shàng wǒmen zǒngjiéle běncì diédài de bùzú.
terms.example_en: In the retrospective, we summarized the shortcomings of this iteration.

terms.definition_en: A meeting to define the work for an upcoming iteration.
terms.definition_zh: 为即将到来的迭代定义工作的会议。
terms.example_zh: 计划会上我们确定了下一个冲刺的目标。
terms.example_pinyin: Jìhuà huì shàng wǒmen quèdìngle xià yī gè chōngcì de mùbiāo.
terms.example_en: In the planning meeting, we set the goals for the next sprint.

terms.definition_en: The process of arranging tasks or events in a timeline.
terms.definition_zh: 安排任务或事件时间线的过程。
terms.example_zh: 我们需要重新排期以应对需求变更。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn pái qī yǐ yìngduì xūqiú biàngēng.
terms.example_en: We need to reschedule to accommodate requirement changes.

terms.definition_en: The process of assigning effort points to tasks.
terms.definition_zh: 为任务分配工作量点的过程。
terms.example_zh: 我们使用故事点进行估点。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen shǐyòng gùshì diǎn jìnxíng gū diǎn.
terms.example_en: We use story points for estimation.

terms.definition_en: A unit of measure for estimating the effort of user stories.
terms.definition_zh: 用于估算用户故事工作量的度量单位。
terms.example_zh: 这个用户故事有5个故事点。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège yònghù gùshì yǒu wǔ gè gùshì diǎn.
terms.example_en: This user story has 5 story points.

terms.definition_en: A fixed time cycle in agile development for delivering increments.
terms.definition_zh: 敏捷开发中固定的时间周期，用于交付增量。
terms.example_zh: 每个迭代持续两周。
terms.example_pinyin: Měi gè diédài chíxù liǎng zhōu.
terms.example_en: Each iteration lasts two weeks.

terms.definition_en: A time-boxed iteration in Scrum, typically 1-4 weeks.
terms.definition_zh: Scrum中的时间盒迭代，通常1-4周。
terms.example_zh: 这个冲刺的目标是完成登录模块。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège chōngcì de mùbiāo shì wánchéng dēnglù mókuài.
terms.example_en: The goal of this sprint is to complete the login module.

terms.definition_en: A prioritized list of work items for a project.
terms.definition_zh: 项目工作项的优先级列表。
terms.example_zh: 产品负责人负责管理待办列表。
terms.example_pinyin: Chǎnpǐn fùzérén fùzé guǎnlǐ dàibàn lièbiǎo.
terms.example_en: The product owner is responsible for managing the backlog.

terms.definition_en: A collection of all proposed features and requirements for a product or project.
terms.definition_zh: 产品或项目所有待实现功能和需求的集合。
terms.example_zh: 请把新功能添加到需求池中。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xīn gōngnéng tiānjiā dào xūqiú chí zhōng.
terms.example_en: Please add the new feature to the requirement pool.

terms.definition_en: The level of importance assigned to a task or requirement.
terms.definition_zh: 分配给任务或需求的重要程度。
terms.example_zh: 这个bug的优先级是P0，必须立即修复。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège bug de yōuxiān jí shì P0, bìxū lìjí xiūfù.
terms.example_en: This bug has priority P0 and must be fixed immediately.

terms.definition_en: An issue that prevents progress on a task or project.
terms.definition_zh: 阻碍任务或项目进展的问题。
terms.example_zh: 数据库连接失败是当前的阻塞项。
terms.example_pinyin: Shùjùkù liánjiē shībài shì dāngqián de zǔsè xiàng.
terms.example_en: The database connection failure is a current blocker.

terms.definition_en: A potential problem that could negatively impact the project.
terms.definition_zh: 可能对项目产生负面影响的潜在问题。
terms.example_zh: 我们需要评估第三方API变更的风险。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào pínggū dìsānfāng API biàngēng de fēngxiǎn.
terms.example_en: We need to assess the risk of third-party API changes.

terms.definition_en: A relationship where one task or component relies on another.
terms.definition_zh: 一个任务或组件依赖于另一个的关系。
terms.example_zh: 这个模块有外部库的依赖。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège mókuài yǒu wàibù kù de yīlài.
terms.example_en: This module has a dependency on an external library.

terms.definition_en: The exchange of information between team members or stakeholders.
terms.definition_zh: 团队成员或利益相关者之间的信息交流。
terms.example_zh: 跨团队沟通需要更频繁一些。
terms.example_pinyin: Kuà tuánduì gōutōng xūyào gèng pínfán yīxiē.
terms.example_en: Cross-team communication needs to be more frequent.

terms.definition_en: Organizing activities of different teams to work together effectively.
terms.definition_zh: 组织不同团队的活动以有效协作。
terms.example_zh: 发布前需要做好各团队的协调工作。
terms.example_pinyin: Fābù qián xūyào zuò hǎo gè tuánduì de xiétiáo gōngzuò.
terms.example_en: We need good coordination among teams before the release.

terms.definition_en: To make data or status consistent across systems or people.
terms.definition_zh: 使数据或状态在系统或人员之间保持一致。
terms.example_zh: 我们每天早会同步进度。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen měitiān zǎohuì tóngbù jìndù.
terms.example_en: We sync progress in the daily standup.

terms.definition_en: Ensuring all parties have a shared understanding and agreement.
terms.definition_zh: 确保各方有共同的理解和一致意见。
terms.example_zh: 我们需要和产品团队对齐需求。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào hé chǎnpǐn tuánduì duìqí xūqiú.
terms.example_en: We need to align requirements with the product team.

terms.definition_en: To verify or validate a fact, decision, or action.
terms.definition_zh: 核实或验证事实、决策或行动。
terms.example_zh: 请确认这个接口的返回格式。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng quèrèn zhège jiēkǒu de fǎnhuí géshì.
terms.example_en: Please confirm the return format of this API.

terms.definition_en: Information about reactions to a product or performance.
terms.definition_zh: 关于产品或表现的反应信息。
terms.example_zh: 用户反馈这个功能很实用。
terms.example_pinyin: Yònghù fǎnkuì zhège gōngnéng hěn shíyòng.
terms.example_en: User feedback says this feature is very useful.

terms.definition_en: An idea or recommendation for improvement.
terms.definition_zh: 改进的想法或推荐。
terms.example_zh: 我建议采用微服务架构。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiànyì cǎiyòng wēifúwù jiàgòu.
terms.example_en: I suggest adopting a microservices architecture.

terms.definition_en: A personal view or judgment about a matter.
terms.definition_zh: 对某事的个人看法或判断。
terms.example_zh: 你的意见很重要，请分享。
terms.example_pinyin: Nǐ de yìjiàn hěn zhòngyào, qǐng fēnxiǎng.
terms.example_en: Your opinion is important, please share.

terms.definition_en: A conversation to exchange ideas and reach understanding.
terms.definition_zh: 交换意见以达成理解的对话。
terms.example_zh: 我们讨论一下技术方案。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen tǎolùn yīxià jìshù fāng'àn.
terms.example_en: Let's discuss the technical solution.

terms.definition_en: A conclusion or resolution reached after consideration.
terms.definition_zh: 经过考虑后达成的结论或决议。
terms.example_zh: 这个决策需要CTO批准。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège juécè xūyào CTO pīzhǔn.
terms.example_en: This decision needs CTO approval.

terms.definition_en: A final judgment or decision reached after analysis.
terms.definition_zh: 分析后得出的最终判断或决定。
terms.example_zh: 会议结论是采用方案B。
terms.example_pinyin: Huìyì jiélùn shì cǎiyòng fāng'àn B.
terms.example_en: The meeting conclusion is to adopt plan B.

terms.definition_en: A specific task assigned to someone with a deadline.
terms.definition_zh: 分配给某人并带有截止日期的具体任务。
terms.example_zh: 这个行动项由小李负责。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège xíngdòng xiàng yóu Xiǎo Lǐ fùzé.
terms.example_en: This action item is assigned to Xiao Li.

terms.definition_en: The person accountable for a task or area.
terms.definition_zh: 对任务或领域负责的人。
terms.example_zh: 谁是这个模块的负责人？
terms.example_pinyin: Shéi shì zhège mókuài de fùzé rén?
terms.example_en: Who is the owner of this module?

terms.definition_en: The latest time by which something must be completed.
terms.definition_zh: 必须完成某事的最晚时间。
terms.example_zh: 这个需求的截止日期是下周五。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège xūqiú de jiézhǐ rìqī shì xià zhōuwǔ.
terms.example_en: The deadline for this requirement is next Friday.

terms.definition_en: To monitor progress or take further action on a matter.
terms.definition_zh: 监控进展或对某事采取进一步行动。
terms.example_zh: 请跟进这个问题的修复情况。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng gēnjìn zhège wèntí de xiūfù qíngkuàng.
terms.example_en: Please follow up on the fix for this issue.

terms.definition_en: To urge someone to act or complete something faster.
terms.definition_zh: 催促某人行动或更快完成某事。
terms.example_zh: 我们需要催促后端团队尽快提供接口。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào cuīcù hòuduān tuánduì jǐnkuài tígōng jiēkǒu.
terms.example_en: We need to push the backend team to provide the API soon.

terms.definition_en: To postpone a task or deadline to a later time.
terms.definition_zh: 将任务或截止日期推迟到更晚的时间。
terms.example_zh: 由于资源不足，项目需要延期两周。
terms.example_pinyin: Yóuyú zīyuán bùzú, xiàngmù xūyào yánqī liǎng zhōu.
terms.example_en: Due to insufficient resources, the project needs a two-week delay.

terms.definition_en: A modification to requirements, scope, or plan.
terms.definition_zh: 对需求、范围或计划的修改。
terms.example_zh: 这个变更需要走审批流程。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège biàngēng xūyào zǒu shěnpī liúchéng.
terms.example_en: This change needs to go through the approval process.

terms.definition_en: The boundaries of a project, including what is included and excluded.
terms.definition_zh: 项目的边界，包括包含和不包含的内容。
terms.example_zh: 我们需要明确这个版本的范围。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào míngquè zhège bǎnběn de fànwéi.
terms.example_en: We need to clarify the scope of this release.

terms.definition_en: Assets such as people, time, or budget available for a project.
terms.definition_zh: 项目可用的人员、时间或预算等资产。
terms.example_zh: 我们需要更多资源来完成这个任务。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào gèng duō zīyuán lái wánchéng zhège rènwù.
terms.example_en: We need more resources to complete this task.

terms.definition_en: The workforce or personnel available for a project or task.
terms.definition_zh: 项目或任务可用的工作人员或人力资源。
terms.example_zh: 这个项目需要增加人力。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào zēngjiā rénlì.
terms.example_en: This project needs more manpower.

terms.definition_en: To deploy a system or feature to production for end users.
terms.definition_zh: 将系统或功能部署到生产环境供最终用户使用。
terms.example_zh: 新功能计划下周一上线。
terms.example_pinyin: Xīn gōngnéng jìhuà xià zhōuyī shàngxiàn.
terms.example_en: The new feature is planned to go live next Monday.

terms.definition_en: To publish a new version of software.
terms.definition_zh: 发布软件的新版本。
terms.example_zh: 我们每个月发版一次。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen měi gè yuè fā bǎn yīcì.
terms.example_en: We release a new version every month.

terms.definition_en: The process of verifying that deliverables meet requirements.
terms.definition_zh: 验证交付物是否符合要求的过程。
terms.example_zh: 客户已经完成了验收测试。
terms.example_pinyin: Kèhù yǐjīng wánchéngle yànshōu cèshì.
terms.example_en: The customer has completed acceptance testing.

terms.definition_en: To formally approve a document or deliverable.
terms.definition_zh: 正式批准文件或交付物。
terms.example_zh: 需要项目经理签字才能发版。
terms.example_pinyin: Xūyào xiàngmù jīnglǐ qiānzì cáinéng fā bǎn.
terms.example_en: The project manager needs to sign off before release.

terms.definition_en: To store data or documents in a long-term repository.
terms.definition_zh: 将数据或文档存入长期存储库。
terms.example_zh: 项目结束后需要归档所有文档。
terms.example_pinyin: Xiàngmù jiéshù hòu xūyào guīdàng suǒyǒu wéndàng.
terms.example_en: All documents need to be archived after the project ends.

terms.definition_en: The process of integrating a new employee into the company.
terms.definition_zh: 让新员工融入公司的过程。
terms.example_zh: 新同事下周开始入职培训。
terms.example_pinyin: Xīn tóngshì xià zhōu kāishǐ rùzhí péixùn.
terms.example_en: The new colleague will start onboarding next week.

terms.definition_en: The transfer of responsibilities or information from one person to another.
terms.definition_zh: 将职责或信息从一个人转移给另一个人。
terms.example_zh: 离职前需要做好工作交接。
terms.example_pinyin: Lízhí qián xūyào zuò hǎo gōngzuò jiāojiē.
terms.example_en: You need to do a proper handover before leaving.

terms.definition_en: To raise an issue to a higher level of management for resolution.
terms.definition_zh: 将问题上报给更高级别的管理层解决。
terms.example_zh: 如果问题无法解决，需要升级到主管。
terms.example_pinyin: Rúguǒ wèntí wúfǎ jiějué, xūyào shēngjí dào zhǔguǎn.
terms.example_en: If the issue cannot be resolved, it needs to be escalated to the supervisor.

terms.definition_en: The fundamental cause of a problem or defect.
terms.definition_zh: 问题或缺陷的根本原因。
terms.example_zh: 我们需要找到这个bug的根因。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zhǎodào zhège bug de gēn yīn.
terms.example_en: We need to find the root cause of this bug.

terms.definition_en: A retrospective analysis after a project or incident to identify improvements.
terms.definition_zh: 项目或事件后的回顾分析，以找出改进点。
terms.example_zh: 事故后我们进行了复盘。
terms.example_pinyin: Shìgù hòu wǒmen jìnxíngle fùpán.
terms.example_en: We conducted a post-mortem after the incident.

terms.definition_en: Knowledge gained from experience that can be applied to future projects.
terms.definition_zh: 从经验中获得的可用于未来项目的知识。
terms.example_zh: 这次复盘总结了很多经验教训。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhè cì fùpán zǒngjiéle hěnduō jīngyàn jiàoxùn.
terms.example_en: This post-mortem summarized many lessons learned.

terms.definition_en: A method or technique that has been proven to produce optimal results.
terms.definition_zh: 已被证明能产生最佳结果的方法或技术。
terms.example_zh: 我们应该遵循代码审查的最佳实践。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zūnxún dàimǎ shěnchá de zuìjiā shíjiàn.
terms.example_en: We should follow best practices for code review.

terms.definition_en: Instructions written in a programming language that a computer can execute.
terms.definition_zh: 用编程语言编写的计算机可执行的指令。
terms.example_zh: 这段代码需要优化。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhè duàn dàimǎ xūyào yōuhuà.
terms.example_en: This code needs to be optimized.

terms.definition_en: The process of creating software or applications.
terms.definition_zh: 创建软件或应用程序的过程。
terms.example_zh: 开发团队正在冲刺新功能。
terms.example_pinyin: Kāifā tuánduì zhèngzài chōngcì xīn gōngnéng.
terms.example_en: The development team is sprinting on new features.

terms.definition_en: The act of writing code to create software.
terms.definition_zh: 编写代码以创建软件的行为。
terms.example_zh: 他擅长Python编程。
terms.example_pinyin: Tā shàncháng Python biānchéng.
terms.example_en: He is good at Python programming.

terms.definition_en: A person who writes computer programs.
terms.definition_zh: 编写计算机程序的人。
terms.example_zh: 程序员需要不断学习新技术。
terms.example_pinyin: Chéngxù yuán xūyào bùduàn xuéxí xīn jìshù.
terms.example_en: Programmers need to continuously learn new technologies.

terms.definition_en: A professional who applies engineering principles to design and build systems.
terms.definition_zh: 应用工程原理设计和构建系统的专业人员。
terms.example_zh: 我们团队有五位软件工程师。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen tuánduì yǒu wǔ wèi ruǎnjiàn gōngchéngshī.
terms.example_en: Our team has five software engineers.

terms.definition_en: A senior engineer who designs the high-level structure of software systems.
terms.definition_zh: 设计软件系统高层结构的高级工程师。
terms.example_zh: 架构师负责系统设计评审。
terms.example_pinyin: Jiàgòushī fùzé xìtǒng shèjì píngshěn.
terms.example_en: The architect is responsible for system design reviews.

terms.definition_en: A team leader responsible for technical decisions and guidance.
terms.definition_zh: 负责技术决策和指导的团队领导。
terms.example_zh: 技术主管需要协调各开发小组。
terms.example_pinyin: Jìshù zhǔguǎn xūyào xiétiáo gè kāifā xiǎozǔ.
terms.example_en: The tech lead needs to coordinate the development teams.

terms.definition_en: A role responsible for defining product vision and requirements.
terms.definition_zh: 负责定义产品愿景和需求的角色。
terms.example_zh: 产品经理正在编写需求文档。
terms.example_pinyin: Chǎnpǐn jīnglǐ zhèngzài biānxiě xūqiú wéndàng.
terms.example_en: The product manager is writing the requirements document.

terms.definition_en: A role responsible for planning, executing, and closing projects.
terms.definition_zh: 负责规划、执行和结束项目的角色。
terms.example_zh: 项目经理制定了项目时间表。
terms.example_pinyin: Xiàngmù jīnglǐ zhìdìngle xiàngmù shíjiānbiǎo.
terms.example_en: The project manager created the project schedule.

terms.definition_en: A system that manages changes to code over time.
terms.definition_zh: 管理代码随时间变化的系统。
terms.example_zh: 我们使用Git进行版本控制。
terms.example_pinyin: Wǒmen shǐyòng Git jìnxíng bǎnběn kòngzhì.
terms.example_en: We use Git for version control.

terms.definition_en: A storage location for source code, often with version control.
terms.definition_zh: 源代码的存储位置，通常带有版本控制。
terms.example_zh: 请把代码推送到远程代码库。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng bǎ dàimǎ tuīsòng dào yuǎnchéng dàimǎ kù.
terms.example_en: Please push the code to the remote code repository.

terms.definition_en: A central location where data or code is stored and managed.
terms.definition_zh: 存储和管理数据或代码的中心位置。
terms.example_zh: 这个仓库包含所有微服务代码。
terms.example_pinyin: Zhège cāngkù bāohán suǒyǒu wēi fúwù dàimǎ.
terms.example_en: This repository contains all microservice code.

terms.definition_en: A parallel version of the codebase used for isolated development.
terms.definition_zh: 代码库的并行版本，用于隔离开发。
terms.example_zh: 请在新分支上开发这个功能。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng zài xīn fēnzhī shàng kāifā zhège gōngnéng.
terms.example_en: Please develop this feature on a new branch.

terms.definition_en: The primary branch of a repository, typically the stable release line.
terms.definition_zh: 仓库的主分支，通常是稳定发布线。
terms.example_zh: 不要直接向主干提交代码。
terms.example_pinyin: Bùyào zhíjiē xiàng zhǔgàn tíjiāo dàimǎ.
terms.example_en: Do not commit code directly to the main branch.

terms.definition_en: To integrate changes from one branch into another.
terms.definition_zh: 将一个分支的更改集成到另一个分支。
terms.example_zh: 请先合并最新的主干代码。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng xiān hébìng zuìxīn de zhǔgàn dàimǎ.
terms.example_en: Please merge the latest main branch code first.

terms.definition_en: A situation where two changes cannot be automatically merged.
terms.definition_zh: 两个更改无法自动合并的情况。
terms.example_zh: 合并时出现了冲突，需要手动解决。
terms.example_pinyin: Hébìng shí chūxiàn le chōngtū, xūyào shǒudòng jiějué.
terms.example_en: A conflict occurred during merge and needs manual resolution.

terms.definition_en: A snapshot of changes saved to the local repository.
terms.definition_zh: 保存到本地仓库的更改快照。
terms.example_zh: 请先提交你的更改再推送。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng xiān tíjiāo nǐ de gēnggǎi zài tuīsòng.
terms.example_en: Please commit your changes before pushing.

terms.definition_en: To upload local commits to a remote repository.
terms.definition_zh: 将本地提交上传到远程仓库。
terms.example_zh: 推送前请确保代码已经测试过。
terms.example_pinyin: Tuīsòng qián qǐng quèbǎo dàimǎ yǐjīng cèshì guò.
terms.example_en: Make sure the code is tested before pushing.

terms.definition_en: To fetch and merge changes from a remote repository.
terms.definition_zh: 从远程仓库获取并合并更改。
terms.example_zh: 每天开始工作前先拉取最新代码。
terms.example_pinyin: Měitiān kāishǐ gōngzuò qián xiān lāqǔ zuìxīn dàimǎ.
terms.example_en: Pull the latest code before starting work each day.

terms.definition_en: To create a local copy of a remote repository.
terms.definition_zh: 创建远程仓库的本地副本。
terms.example_zh: 请先克隆项目到本地。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng xiān kèlóng xiàngmù dào běndì.
terms.example_en: Please clone the project to your local machine first.

terms.definition_en: A personal copy of another user's repository on a hosting service.
terms.definition_zh: 托管服务上其他用户仓库的个人副本。
terms.example_zh: 你可以分叉这个仓库来贡献代码。
terms.example_pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ fēnchā zhège cāngkù lái gòngxiàn dàimǎ.
terms.example_en: You can fork this repository to contribute code.

terms.definition_en: A request to merge changes from one branch into another, often used for code review.
terms.definition_zh: 将一个分支的更改合并到另一个分支的请求，常用于代码审查。
terms.example_zh: 请提交一个拉取请求以便代码审查。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng tíjiāo yī gè lāqǔ qǐngqiú yǐbiàn dàimǎ shěnchá.
terms.example_en: Please submit a pull request for code review.

terms.definition_en: Systematic examination of source code to find and fix mistakes.
terms.definition_zh: 对源代码进行系统性检查以发现并修复错误。
terms.example_zh: 代码审查是保证代码质量的重要环节。
terms.example_pinyin: Dàimǎ shěnchá shì bǎozhèng dàimǎ zhìliàng de zhòngyào huánjié.
terms.example_en: Code review is an important step to ensure code quality.

terms.definition_en: The act of evaluating code changes, often in a pull request.
terms.definition_zh: 评估代码更改的行为，通常在拉取请求中进行。
terms.example_zh: 请评审我的拉取请求。
terms.example_pinyin: Qǐng píngshěn wǒ de lāqǔ qǐngqiú.
terms.example_en: Please review my pull request.

terms.definition_en: To translate source code into executable machine code.
